name: DrillGraphPage

tests.name: DrillGraphPage — a drillable graph at the desktop's positions

whenUse: A graph workspace whose grouping and layout were already computed elsewhere — tabs, levels keyed by drill path, positioned nodes — drawn as-is with drill, back and an inspector. The page a paired phone renders for every graph.
whenNot: Raw { nodes, edges } that still need laying out — use NetworkPage. A single-parent hierarchy — use TreeExplorerPage.
